name: Throw Full Stack
summary: Allows you to hover on a item and press shift and press q once on the item to throw the entire stack out of your inventory
description: # Full Stack Throw (Shift + Q) ## Description **Full Stack Throw** is a simple client-side mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that enhances your inventory management. It allows you to drop an entire item stack at once, rather than just a single item, with a convenient key combination. ### How It Works (for the user) - Hold the **Shift** key. - Hover your mouse over any item stack in your inventory (including the hotbar). - Press **Q** (the default drop key). The entire stack will be thrown out of your inventory onto the ground in one go. No more spamming Q or dragging stacks out—just one quick action to clear a slot. ### Features - Works in all inventory screens (player inventory, chests, etc.) as long as you are hovering over a stack. - Fully client-side: no server installation required, and it works on any multiplayer server. - No configuration needed—just install and play. - Compatible with other mods that use the inventory or key bindings.
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
